paper.title: Bias no more: high-probability data-dependent regret bounds for adversarial bandits and MDPs

unmapped: losses in [0,1]^d; the paper's d is the number of arms (K here)
regret is actual (realized) regret, not pseudo-regret
settings.definition_quote: For each round $t = 1, \ldots, T$, the learner selects one of the $d$ available actions $i_t \in [d]$, while simultaneously the adversary decides a loss vector $\ell_t \in [0,1]^d$ ... An adaptive adversary can choose $\ell_t$ based on the learner's previous actions

unmapped: arbitrary convex body Omega with a nu-self-concordant barrier given to the learner
losses normalized so that max_{w in Omega} |<w, l_t>| <= 1
settings.definition_quote: Linear bandits generalize MAB from the simplex decision set $\Delta_d$ to an arbitrary convex body $\Omega \subseteq \fR^d$. ... the adversary decides a loss vector $\ell_t \in \fR^d$, assumed to be normalized such that $\max_{w\in\Omega} |\inner{w, \ell_t}| \leq 1$.

unmapped: arbitrary convex body Omega with a nu-self-concordant barrier given to the learner
losses normalized so that max_{w in Omega} |<w, l_t>| <= 1
settings.definition_quote: Again, an adaptive adversary can choose $\ell_t$ based on the learner's previous actions, while an oblivious adversary cannot.

settings.name_in_paper: Episodic adversarial MDP with unknown transition and bandit feedback
unmapped: episodic layered tabular MDP with J layers, state space X, action space A; learner chooses policies
unknown stochastic transition kernel; adversarial losses in [0,1] per state-action
regret against best fixed policy in expected loss
settings.definition_quote: We consider an episodic MDP setting with finite horizon, unknown transition kernel, bandit feedback, and adversarial losses, the exact same setting as the recent work~\citep{jin2019learning}

algorithms.name: OMD with log-barrier and increasing learning rates (Algorithm 1)

requires_knowledge_of: L_star (for tuning eta; removable by doubling trick)

symbols.L_star: total loss of the best arm, min_i sum_t l_{t,i}

extra_assumptions: eta tuned using L_star (doubling trick claimed to remove this)

source.label: thm:MAB
source.quote: \pref{alg:mab} with a suitable choice of $\eta$ ensures that with probability at least $1-\delta$, $\Reg=\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}\big(\sqrt{d\Lstar\ln(\nicefrac{d}{\delta})}+d\ln(\nicefrac{d}{\delta})\big)$, where $\Lstar = \min_i \sum_{t=1}^T \ell_{t,i}$ is the loss of the best arm.

results.notes: Paper's d = number of arms (K). Holds against adaptive adversary (union bound over arms in proof).

symbols.nu: self-concordance parameter of the barrier psi for Omega

source.label: thm:LB
source.quote: \pref{alg:linear bandit d+1} with a suitable choice of $\eta$ ensures that with probability at least $1-\delta$: $\Reg = \otil\left(d^2\nu\sqrt{ T\ln\frac{1}{\delta}}+d^2\nu\ln\frac{1}{\delta}\right)$ against an oblivious adversary; ...

symbols.nu: self-concordance parameter of the barrier psi for Omega

bound.expression_latex: T in the bounds above replaced by L^\star

extra_assumptions: <w, l_t> >= 0 for all w in Omega and all t
eta tuned using L_T (doubling trick claimed)

source.label: thm:LB
source.quote: Moreover, if $\inner{w, \ell_t} \geq 0$ for all $w\in\Omega$ and all $t$, then $T$ in the bounds above can be replaced by $L^\star = \min_{u\in\Omega}\sum_{t=1}^T \inner{u, \ell_t}$

bound.expression_latex: T in the bounds above replaced by L^\star

extra_assumptions: <w, l_t> >= 0 for all w in Omega and all t
eta tuned using L_T (doubling trick claimed)

source.label: thm:LB
source.quote: Moreover, if $\inner{w, \ell_t} \geq 0$ for all $w\in\Omega$ and all $t$, then $T$ in the bounds above can be replaced by $L^\star$

results.notes: Small-loss version, adaptive; obtained by substituting L* for T in the adaptive bound as the theorem states.

symbols.L_star: total expected loss of best policy, <= J*T

extra_assumptions: eta tuned using L_star (doubling trick claimed)

source.label: thm:MDP
source.quote: \pref{alg:MDP} with a suitable choice of $\eta$ ensures that with probability at least $1-\delta$, $\Reg = \otil\left(|X|\sqrt{\Lyr|A| L^{\star}\ln \frac{1}{\delta}}+|X|^5 |A|^2\ln^2 \frac{1}{\delta}\right)$, where $\Lstar = \min_{\pi}\sum_{t=1}^T \ell_t(\pi) \leq \Lyr T$

results.notes: Paper states the bound holds for both oblivious and adaptive adversaries; recorded under adaptive. Regret is in terms of expected policy loss.
